Fit4Racing is a Mountain Bike Fitness Coach in your pocket. Developed exclusively for the needs of mountain bikers - pro to amateur. Here's how a Fit4Racing program can help you:

• Test and Compare your metrics - Use testing methods specific to MTB performance then compare yourself to other riders. Our testing and benchmarking feature is unique to the Fit4Racing app, nowhere else can you check how you perform on key performance metrics vs other riders. Years of data is already there for you to compare against.

• Trusted by pros - The Fit4Racing programs are built using unique data and training methodologies developed over years of training world class podium riders, but scalable for all. Over 5000 amateurs and numerous pros have already benefitted from a Fit4Racing program.

• Choose the program that is right for you -  Enduro, Downhill, Home Workouts or Workout of the Week. All programs are scalable to your fitness and skill level. No generic programs here, target your specific goals with science based training programs. 

• New workouts every week - Don't follow an off-the-shelf program, Fit4Racing is new every single week! New program, new videos, new gains, every Sunday, without fail. You'll never be bored training again, and your strength and fitness will improve with the constant variation and stimulus changes.

• Video demos, but not as you know them - Detailed videos are with you at every stage of your program. Filmed every week so you know exactly how to perform the movements in the most optimal and safe way for that days workout, this is THE ONLY WAY you get the coach-in-your-pocket feeling. Never guess your training again!

• No contracts, super flexible - Change programs or cancel any time, the power is in your hands. We are proud of our program and expect you'll follow it FOREVER! But when the sun is shining you'll want to ride more, we understand. So we make it easy for you to downgrade to a cheaper, more simple program and maintain what you've worked for during busy bike times. 

• Semi-periodised for your summer season - Choose between Northern and Southern hemisphere to maximise your riding season. Don't worry though, you'll continually improve your bike readiness regardless of where you are in the off/on season, semi-periodised means you'll forever make progress and feel better on the bike 12 months of the year.

• Benchmarks to test you like never before - Our benchmark workouts are designed around the demands of MTB, complete them and compare your scores against hundreds of other riders. Use these unique workouts to gauge your current physical ability, not just strength or FTP but where it counts.

Fit4Racing is strength and conditioning for riders who are serious about improving their physicality for MTB. We use modern sports science techniques alongside data and experience we have collected over years of training professional and amateur mountain bikers. Fit4Racing was the "original MTB online program" and has been followed by over 5000 mountain bikers in 72 countries for over 6 years. This app is a unique combination of our famous weekly programs with supporting videos and our new and exclusive metrics recording and comparison feature. Now, for the first time ever you can compare your results in key strength and fitness areas agains other riders! Some of our benchmarks have pro riders scores for you to aim for... or can you even beat them? Sign up and see for yourself.
